layer_at_fault_line: Four mark cells (Split of persisters vs non-persisters: 'Built, then fitted'; Harms list: 'Fitted'; Awareness -> use: 'Asserted'; Social desirability/backfire: 'Catch-alls') give provenance words or other non-mark labels in the Mark column instead of one of the eight marks; SKILL.md is explicit that 'asserted is not a mark' and 'a word from one list never stands in another's place', so this is the reader mixing lists, not something the skill's wording pushed the reader toward.
quotes: test_poke (NAME ONLY, one half only): 'Half of that poke is already runnable – send the same form titled "Learning Styles" to a matched group. If the numbers move, the anti-bias part is held; if not, it is decoration.' -- no paired change that the report says would NOT move the outcome is given next to the disputed line. | test_reverse (NAME ONLY, direction named, no separate poke of cause and effect): '"Participants use techniques they consider effective, so raising awareness raises use." The same one page of self-report supports the reverse: people rate as effective what they already do. "It seems reasonable to infer" is the tell.' | pull sentences whose sides are not part-list labels (test_pull RAN, pairs_that_pull left empty): '"Reassuring" and "pessimistic" readings of the same 33% sit in one discussion with nothing to decide between them.' and '"Raise awareness of effective methods" pulls against "debunking may backfire".' | mark cells outside the closed list (marks_outside_closed_list = 4): 'Split of persisters vs non-persisters | Built, then fitted | Designed as description, but run post hoc at a reviewer's request; it says who, not why.'; 'Harms list drawn from prior papers | Fitted | Tuned on the same sources whose conclusion the paper then recommends.'; 'Awareness → use ("it seems reasonable to infer") | Asserted | One-off self-reports; the arrow could run the other way. Never poked.'; 'Social desirability, backfire effect | Catch-alls | Both absorb any result. No gauge given.'
